metadata.description: sf-intelligence marketplace — an offline-first, MCP-first knowledge base for one Salesforce org.

plugins.name: sf-intelligence
plugins.description: Answers questions about one Salesforce org from a local, read-only metadata snapshot: what a field is used by, what breaks if you delete or change something, why a user cannot see a record, what runs on save, and whether a deployment is safe. Works offline; never writes to the org. FIRST RUN: this plugin cannot know where your vault lives, so set SFI_VAULT to the absolute path of your org-kb folder, or launch the host from the folder that holds it. If answers come back empty, ask "is the server set up?" (sfi.setup_status) for where it looked and the commands to build a vault. Ask "what can you do?" for the live tool map.
